calculation.description: Negative same-session open-to-close return, using only completed daily OHLC data; higher values identify assets that fell intraday and are expected to mean-revert on the next session. Signal is formed after the session closes and is paired with next-session close-to-close return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive daily IC in every calendar year: 2020 0.02988, 2021 0.05767, 2022 0.05686, 2023 0.04521, 2024 0.06036, 2025 0.05442, 2026 through cutoff 0.03781. Cross-section is the full 15-asset tradable universe; dates require at least 8 valid instruments.
validation.provenance: Date-aligned Spearman cross-sectional IC; signal rows=26034 and symbols=15. Correlation audit against available simple factor artifacts/definitions found low correlation (maximum absolute reported pairwise correlation 0.1918).
